remarks: Regents Park... One of the premiere condominium communities in Westport Connecticut. This is an end unit with fabulous flow for living. Located within walking distance for the clubhouse pool and tennis. Immaculately maintained this unit is a gem. Open floorplan for kitchen dining and sunken living room leading to outdoor patio. Primary suite and guest suite each with full bath on second floor and third floor with wonderful open space/3rd bedroom and large full bath allow for fabulous living spaces. Carpeted lower level is totally finished with wonderful built-ins and large space for a private Family room. Adjacent to this wonderful space is a large office space/ den or playroom. Located near all that Westport has to offer, this Wellington unit is truly one of a kind.
